imageVideo.notes: KIE.ai is OFF. Enabling image or video generation starts a recurring vendor spend, so it stays off until the owner approves it. The same change that sets enabled true must set ceilingUsd to a per-request USD cap: routeRequest refuses the vendor while the ceiling is null.

notes.routing: Every rule is inert while enabled is false: routeRequest returns the current model with reason default. Enabling routing is a deliberate operator action, not a default.
notes.cdr: PII-bearing requests route to cdr. With routing enabled and cdr null, routeRequest refuses the request instead of sending personal data to the default hosted model.
notes.freeLocal: Research and exploration route to freeLocal when the operator serves a local model. With freeLocal null they stay on the current model.
notes.imageVideo: Image and video requests route to KIE.ai only when enabled is true and ceilingUsd is set. Until then they stay on the current model and the reason still says image-video.
notes.code: Code requests keep the default model. Set code only to move them deliberately; the signal patterns live in llm-routing.ts.
